_comment: Ajuntament de Barcelona open data, read by mapsee_ingest_barcelona.py through the CKAN datastore API only (a documented public API: catalog_curate.DOCUMENTED_API_TYPES has ckan; and so exempt from robots.txt; the portal's /robots.txt answers 302 to /challenge, a 'Bot Detection' page, 2026-10-05). The JSON download of the same resource redirects to /challenge and the ASIA XML feeds on w10.bcn.cat are refused by robots.txt: neither is ever requested. Read the adapter header before changing a rule: only what anyone can turn up to at a community facility is written, and every price sentence is read by ../mapsee migration 0227 as an offer tag.
_crawl_delay: The portal states none (its /robots.txt is a bot-challenge page, not a file); one request a second anyway. A run is 2 requests.
attribution: Font: Ajuntament de Barcelona, «Agenda d'actes i activitats de la ciutat» i «Equipaments de cultura i lleure» (Guia BCN), dades obertes CC BY 4.0.
_bbox: south, west, north, east: the municipality and its edges. Rows for Sitges, Montmelo and the like carry a placeholder point and no City road id; this box is the second guard after the address join.
_join_max_m: Address joined to a facility (road id + street number), and the row's point within this of the facility's (whose point is then used). Measured 2026-10-03: 2,672 of 2,753 joined rows within 1 m; Brusi 51 (Espai Jove Casa Sagnier) 205 m and Ronda del Guinardo 113 (Centre Civic Guinardo) 138 m are the same buildings geocoded twice.
_link_template: The City's public page per register id. robots.txt (guia.barcelona.cat) allows /ca/detall/ with Crawl-delay 10; the server ignores the slug (a wrong one returned the same 200 page, 2026-10-05). Never fetched by this adapter; mapsee_prune_cancelled.py probes it as the row's Tickets / info link and keeps the 10 s Crawl-delay (probe_all).
venue_kinds: Casals i espais per a joves
_venue_kinds: secondary_filters_name values in the culture-and-leisure facility register, best name first: when one building holds a centre civic and a library, the centre civic names it. Plain 'Biblioteques' is left out on purpose: it is museum, university and archive libraries (L'Auditori, the Fundacio Tapies, MACBA), and joined to it 101 rows were their exhibitions and concerts.
_museum_kinds: An address that also holds a museum: a row is kept only AT the community facility's own point and nearer it than the museum's (Casal de l'Avi Barça shares its number with the Barça museum; the Palau Blaugrana's 13 basketball matches sit 102 m from the casal). Where the museum and the facility are ONE point the point cannot tell, and the row is refused unless the address is in museum_shared_kept: L'Auditori (its documentation library is filed as municipal; 63 agenda rows in the window, its season; of the 4 registers that pass every other rule, 2 are the Museu de la Música's 6 EUR exhibitions), Disseny Hub with Biblioteca El Clot - Josep Benet (Glòries 37: of 9 registers that pass, 6 are exhibitions in Disseny Hub's galleries, one at 6 EUR, and 3 the library's), La Fabra with Ateneu L'Harmonia (Fabra i Coats: all 10 that pass are La Fabra's or Fàbrica de Creació's exhibitions, festivals and concerts, none the Ateneu's). Measured 2026-10-05.

museum_shared_kept.name: Centre Cívic Convent de Sant Agustí (Comerç 36), with the Museu de la Xocolata

_museum_shared_kept: Reviewed addresses where a museum and a community facility share one point and the rows that pass every other rule are the centre's own. Comerç 36, 2026-10-05: the centre civic's families' Fridays, Tardes Gamer, its exhibitions and Sala Noble shows; the Museu de la Xocolata's workshops ask for registration and are refused by that rule. Add an address only after reading what it would admit; the museum is named under 'Same building'.
_skip_dates: Public holidays in Barcelona (Spain, Catalonia and the city's own: Segona Pasqua 17 May 2027, La Merce 24 Sep). Not written for a WEEKLY pattern only; an explicit date in the row is the source's claim and is kept. The adapter warns when the list ends before the horizon.

sources.name: Barcelona - agenda at community places
sources._resource: agenda-diaria, the Guia BCN export as a CSV mirrored into the datastore, rebuilt daily (max modified 2026-10-02 on a 2026-10-03 read). One row per register_id (5,957 of 5,957 unique).
sources._facilities: equipament-cultura-i-lleure (Llista d'equipaments de cultura i lleure), 3,046 rows / 2,432 facilities on 2026-10-05; one row per facility and filter.
sources._category_by_title_word: The City titles a row by its kind first ('Concert ...', 'Xerrada ...', 'Exposicio ...'); the first word decides, the sync's derive_categories may still promote (kids, fitness).
